blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.
blocks.zh: 许多体现的世界模型预测未来处于为RGB重建所优化的潜在空间中的状态,这些空间没有明确优先考虑与运动生成相关的对象级语义和几何. 我们提出 MotionRep,一种视觉表现世界模型,它联合生成未来的DINO表示和3D对象流,将语义和几何信息与以物体为中心的动态相接. 为了让高维的DINO特征适应基因模型,我们引入了DINO-VAE,它将时间和通道压缩与潜在正态相结合,在保存语义和几何信息的同时产生紧凑的潜质. 以初始观测为条件,对象查询点,语言指示,统一扩散变压器预测未来视觉表现和3D对象通过联合关注来流动. 动议 Rep使用非对称模式特定噪声表,使视觉流在联想解析时能先于3D物体流出,使未来视觉表现逐渐被精炼来引导流出. 关于模拟和现实世界操纵基准的实验表明,MotionRep在3D对象流精度和通向不见场景的平面基线上超越了以像素为基础的基准,同时只需要三个去名步骤即可推论. 这些结果支持预测视觉表现作为以物体为中心的动态模型的有效未来状态空间.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Effective robotic manipulation requires reasoning beyond the current observation to anticipate future object dynamics.
3D object flow explicitly represents the trajectories of object points in 3D space, providing a natural description of future physical dynamics ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) .
Recent 3D object flow world models incorporate future visual state modeling to support motion generation, making the choice of visual representation a critical design decision ( Li et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
有效的机器人操纵需要超出当前观测的推理来预测未来的物体动态.
三维物体流明确代表了三维空间中物体点的轨迹,为未来的物理动力学提供了自然的描述(袁等,2024.
近期的3D对象流世界模型将未来的视觉状态模型纳入支持运动生成,使视觉表现的选择成为关键的设计决定(Li等,2025;Lu等,2026b.).

blocks.en:
Existing 3D object flow world models commonly predict future states in pixel-reconstruction-oriented latent spaces ( Li et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , which preserve substantial low-level texture and appearance details but do not explicitly prioritize object semantics and spatial geometry relevant to motion prediction ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . Modeling such complex appearance details can increase inference cost and limit generalization to unseen scenes.
In contrast, visual representation world models predict future states rich in semantic and geometric information ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
However, these approaches primarily focus on visual representation prediction, while jointly modeling visual representations and 3D object flow remains underexplored.

相形之下,视觉表现世界模型预测出未来具有丰富的语义和几何信息的国家(周等,2025;阿斯兰等,2025;郭等,2026.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we introduce MotionRep, a visual representation world model for object-centric dynamics that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, modeling future visual states in the DINO representation space rather than pixel-reconstruction-oriented latent spaces (Fig. 1 ).
Although DINO representations capture rich semantic and geometric information ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , their high dimensionality and unregularized feature distributions limit direct diffusion modeling ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ) .
We therefore introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact generative latents while preserving informative feature structure.
Building on this representation, MotionRep generates future visual representations and 3D object flow using a diffusion transformer, enabling direct interaction between visual states and object dynamics through joint attention.
Furthermore, we introduce decoupled timestep sampling and modality-specific noise schedules, allowing future visual representations to be progressively denoised ahead of 3D object flow and continuously guide motion generation in a latent-forcing manner.

为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了MotionRep,这是以物体为中心的动态的视觉表现世界模型,它联合生成未来的DINO表示和3D对象流,在DINO表示空间中模拟未来的视觉状态,而不是像素重建导向的潜在空间(图一.
虽然DINO表示法捕捉到丰富的语义和几何信息(Siméoni等,2025年),但其高维度和不规范的特征分布限制了直接扩散模型(Zheng等,2026;Bi等,2026年).
因此,我们引入了DINO-VAE,它将时间压缩和信道压缩与潜在的正态化结合起来,产生紧凑的基因潜质,同时保留信息丰富的特征结构。
以这种表示为基础,MotionRep利用扩散变压器生成未来的视觉表现和3D对象流,通过联合关注,使视觉状态和物体动态之间能够直接相互作用.
此外,我们采用分解的时间步取样和特定方式的噪音表,使未来的视觉表现在三维物体流之前逐渐去除,并以潜在的强制方式不断引导运动产生。

blocks.en:
Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep achieves state-of-the-art 3D object flow prediction performance, generalizes to unseen scenes, and enables efficient generation with only three sampling steps.
Representation analyses show that DINO-VAE preserves semantic and geometric information in compressed latents.
Ablation studies further validate the contributions of DINO-VAE, future DINO generation, modality-specific noise scheduling, and representation world model pretraining to 3D object flow generation.
Conditional inference experiments demonstrate that MotionRep supports both visual-conditioned inverse dynamics and flow-conditioned forward dynamics within the same model, revealing bidirectional dependencies between future visual representations and 3D object motion.

表现分析显示,DINO-VAE在压缩潜伏物中保存了语义和几何信息.
配乐研究进一步验证了DINO-VAE,未来DINO生成,模式特异性噪声调度,以及表现世界模型预训对3D对象流生成的贡献.
有条件的推论实验表明,MotionRep支持视觉条件的逆向动态和同模型内的流向前向动态,揭示出未来视觉表现和3D物体运动之间的双向依赖.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We demonstrate the value of explicitly predicting future visual representations for 3D object flow generation, and introduce MotionRep to jointly model future DINO representations and object motion. • We introduce DINO-VAE, which makes dense DINO features amenable to generative modeling through temporal and channel compression and latent regularization, while preserving semantic and geometric information. • We develop an asymmetric denoising strategy with decoupled timesteps and modality-specific noise schedules, enabling representation-guided flow generation and bidirectional conditional dynamics modeling.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of MotionRep. DINO-VAE compresses high-dimensional DINO features into compact visual latents, while modality-specific noise schedules enable asymmetric denoising, allowing progressively refined visual representations to guide 3D object flow generation.

blocks.en:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models directly predict robot actions from multimodal observations ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Brohan et al., 2023 ) , while world action models (WAMs) incorporate future state prediction to explicitly model environment dynamics ( Du et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) . However, video generation world models primarily focus on visual scene evolution and often lack explicit representations of 3D object motion.
In contrast, 3D object flow captures object dynamics through 3D point trajectories, providing explicit geometric and motion information for robotic manipulation ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhi et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
Existing 3D object flow generation methods follow two paradigms. Two-stage approaches generate future videos and recover 3D trajectories using point trackers ( Li et al., 2025 ; Karaev et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Karhade et al., 2025 ) , suffering from accumulated generation and tracking errors. Single-stage approaches directly generate 3D object flow ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , with some methods further jointly generating future videos ( Lu et al., 2026b ) . However, direct flow generation often lacks explicit future state guidance, while joint video-flow models typically rely on pixel-oriented VAE latents, which may not fully capture semantic and geometric information. In contrast, MotionRep jointly generates future visual representations and 3D object flow in the semantically and geometrically rich DINO representation space, providing more informative future state guidance for 3D motion generation.
blocks.zh:
远景-语言-行动(VLA)模型直接通过多模式观测预测机器人动作(Kim等,2024;Black等,2024;Brohan等,2023;而世界行动模型(WAMS)包含未来状态预测,以明确模拟环境动态(Du等,2023;Li等,2026b; Tian等,2025;Ye等,2026;Hu等,2024.). 然而,视频生成世界模型主要侧重于视觉场景演化,并经常缺乏3D物体运动的明确表现.
相形之下,3D物体流通过3D点轨迹来捕捉物体动力学,为机器人操纵提供了明确的几何和运动信息(袁等,2024;志等,2025;林等,2026.
现有的3D对象流生成方法遵循了两个范式. 双相相相方法利用点追踪器生成未来视频并恢复3D轨迹(Li等,2025;Karaev等,2024;Lu等,2026a;Karhade等,2025;),出现累积生成和跟踪错误. 单相相方法直接生成3D对象流(Lee等,2026;Lee等,2025;Zhang等,2026;Li等,2026a),一些方法进一步联合生成未来的视频(Lu等,2026b.). 然而,直接流量生成往往缺乏明确的未来状态引导,而联合视频流量模型一般依赖于以像素为导向的VAE潜伏,这些潜伏可能无法完全捕捉到语义和几何信息. 相形之下,MotionRep联合生成了未来视觉表现和3D对象流在相形相形和相形相形相形相形丰富的DINO代表空间,为3D运动生成提供了更丰富的未来状态指导.

blocks.en:
Most video world models operate in pixel VAE latent spaces optimized for visual reconstruction ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ; Blattmann et al., 2023a ; Blattmann et al., 2023b ) , devoting substantial capacity to low-level appearance details that may be less relevant to dynamics modeling. In contrast, self-supervised visual models such as DINO and V-JEPA learn representations rich in semantic and spatial information ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Amir et al., 2021 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . Recent studies have explored these representations for generative modeling, either to improve optimization ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) or as direct generation spaces ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , demonstrating faster convergence and improved generation quality.
However, much of the progress in representation-based generation has been demonstrated on images ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , while high-dimensional features ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and temporal redundancy pose additional challenges for video generation. Meanwhile, world models operating in visual representation spaces primarily predict future visual states ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Boduljak et al., 2025 ) , leaving their potential for guiding 3D object motion generation underexplored. Unlike approaches that generate directly in high-dimensional representation spaces, MotionRep introduces DINO-VAE to construct a compact generative latent space and jointly models future visual representations and 3D object flow, leveraging rich semantic and geometric information to guide 3D motion generation.
blocks.zh:
大部分视频世界模型运行于为视觉重建而优化的像素VAE潜在空间(Rombach等,2022年;Yang等,2025年;Wan Team等,2025年;Blatmann等,2023年a;Blatmann等,2023年b),将大量容量用于可能与动态建模不太相关的低等外观细节. 相比之下,DINO和V-JEPA等自我监督的视觉模型学习了丰富的语义和空间信息(Caron等,2021;Oquab等,2024;Amir等,2021;Bardes等,2024;Siméoni等,2025;Assran等,2025). 最近的研究探讨了基因模型的这些表达方式,或者是为了改进优化(Yu等,2025;Yao等,2025;或作为直接生成空间(Zheng等,2026;Singh等,2026;Guo等,2026;Xie等,2026)),显示出更快的趋同和更好的生成质量.
然而,在以代表为主的生成方面,许多进展已经在图像上得到展示(Yu等,2025;Yao等,2025;Zheng等,2026),而高维特性(Zheng等,2026)和时间冗余为视频生成带来了额外的挑战. 同时,在视觉表现空间中运行的世界模型主要预测出未来的视觉状态(周等,2025;阿斯兰等,2025;博杜利亚克等,2025),使其引导3D物体运动生成的潜力未得到充分探索. 与在高维表达空间直接生成的方法不同,MotionRep引入了DINO-VAE来构建紧凑的基因潜入空间并联合模拟未来的视觉表达和3D对象流,利用丰富的语义和几何信息来指导3D运动生成.

blocks.en: Overview. The framework of MotionRep is illustrated in Fig. 2 . First, we use a frozen DINO encoder to extract visual features with rich semantic and spatial structure, and employ DINO-VAE to compress the high-dimensional DINO features into compact latent representations suitable for generative modeling (Sec. 3.2 ). MotionRep then jointly models future visual representations and 3D object flow within a unified generative framework (Sec. 3.3 ). Finally, we introduce modality-specific timestep sampling and noise schedules to model cross-modal conditional dependencies under different noise levels (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Visual Representation Compression
blocks.zh: 3.2 视觉表现压缩

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of DINO-VAE. DINO-VAE compresses high-dimensional DINO features through temporal attention pooling and a causal ViT encoder, achieving 4 × 4\times temporal and 8 × 8\times channel compression. KL regularization facilitates generative modeling in the latent space, while a causal ViT decoder reconstructs the DINO features.
blocks.zh: 图3:DINO-VAE概览。 DINO-VAE 压缩高维度 DINO的特性通过时间注意力集合和一个因果VIT编码器,实现4×4相时和8×8相时的信道压缩. KL正规化有利于潜入空间中的基因模型,而因果VIT解码器则重建出DINO特征.

blocks.en:
Visual representation models such as DINO ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) provide rich object-level semantics and spatial-geometric structure, yet their raw features are not tailored to generative modeling.
As shown in Fig. 3 , we therefore introduce DINO-VAE to compress DINO features into a compact latent space while preserving their semantic and geometric structure.
blocks.zh:
DINO等视觉表现模型(Siméoni等,2025年)提供了丰富的对象层次语义和空间几何结构,然而其原始特征并不适应基因模型.
如图3所示,我们因此引入了DINO-VAE,将DINO特征压缩为紧凑的潜入空间,同时保留其语义和几何结构.

blocks.en:
Temporal and Channel Compression. Given an input video V ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ) × H × W × 3 V\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T)\times H\times W\times 3} , we employ DINOv3-L to extract patch-level features X ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ) × H 16 × W 16 × 1024 X\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T)\times\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times 1024} .
Since frame-wise DINO features exhibit substantial temporal redundancy, modeling every frame independently introduces unnecessary computational overhead. We therefore employ an attention pooling module that aggregates every four consecutive frames into one temporal latent, followed by a linear projection to the ViT hidden dimension, yielding X ′ ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T 4 ) × H 16 × W 16 × D X^{\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+\frac{T}{4})\times\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times D} .
Direct diffusion modeling in the high-dimensional DINO feature space is challenging, as informative semantic and geometric structures are often concentrated in a lower-dimensional subspace. Corrupting and denoising the full feature space requires the generative model to account for numerous directions that contribute little to the underlying representation structure, thereby increasing optimization difficulty.
We therefore feed X ′ X^{\prime} into a causal ViT encoder to model channel-wise interactions and causal spatiotemporal dependencies, followed by a linear projection to obtain compact DINO-VAE latents Z ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T 4 ) × H 16 × W 16 × d Z\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+\frac{T}{4})\times\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times d} , where d = 128 d=128 . We adopt a lightweight ViT encoder to preserve the semantic and geometric structure of the original DINO features, while employing a ViT decoder to enhance reconstruction fidelity. Finally, temporal unpatchification restores the decoded representations to the original DINO feature space, yielding reconstructed features X ^ ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ) × H 16 × W 16 × 1024 \hat{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T)\times\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times 1024} .

blocks.en: 3.3 Unified Representation and Flow Modeling

blocks.en: Building on the compact visual latents produced by DINO-VAE, MotionRep jointly models future visual representations and object-centric dynamics in a unified generative framework, as shown in Fig. 2 . MotionRep employs DINO features to represent the evolution of future states, while explicitly modeling the 3D motion and geometric changes of target objects through 3D object flow.

blocks.en:
3D Object Flow Encoding. We use the definition of 3D object flow from Sec. 3.1 . Since flow is represented directly in metric 3D space, its numerical scale can differ substantially from the Gaussian noise used in diffusion-based generative modeling. We therefore normalize flow with a global scale factor s flow s_{\mathrm{flow}} as F ~ t , p = F t , p s flow \tilde{F}_{t,p}=\frac{F_{t,p}}{s_{\mathrm{flow}}} , yielding a representation whose scale is better suited for diffusion-based generation.
To associate each flow token with its corresponding geometric location, we further use the initial 3D coordinate P 0 , p P_{0,p} as a geometric anchor. Specifically, we separately encode the global 3D position of each point and its local geometry relative to the object centroid, and fuse the two as the 3D geometric positional encoding for each flow token.

blocks.en:
Cross-Modal Dynamics Modeling. We then concatenate the representation latent sequence produced by DINO-VAE with the flow token sequence, and feed them into a unified diffusion transformer together with the clean initial object points P 0 P_{0} for joint modeling.
Joint attention allows visual and flow tokens to interact bidirectionally: predicted future visual states can guide flow generation, while flow provides explicit object-motion information for predicting future scene states.
To further capture cross-modal spatiotemporal correspondences, we introduce spatiotemporal RoPE. We assign spatial coordinates to each flow token based on the image-plane location of its initial 3D point P 0 , p P_{0,p} in the DINO feature map, while aligning its temporal coordinate with the corresponding DINO latent timestep, thereby establishing explicit cross-modal spatiotemporal alignment within joint attention.
Finally, separate output heads project the visual and flow representations back into their corresponding spaces, yielding the predicted future visual latents and 3D object flow.
Furthermore, the generated DINO representations can support downstream tasks such as RGB reconstruction, depth estimation, and semantic segmentation through task-specific decoders. Implementation details are provided in the Appendix.

blocks.en: Unified Multi-Task Inference. After training, MotionRep supports multiple inference modes by configuring the noise states and denoising trajectories of the two modalities. In joint generation, the two streams share the same solver steps, while modality-specific noise schedules keep the visual representation stream ahead of flow in denoising progress, with flow remaining at a relatively higher noise level. This creates a latent-forcing-style asymmetric denoising trajectory, in which progressively refined future visual representations continuously provide informative state constraints for flow generation.

blocks.en: MotionRep achieves strong trajectory prediction performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating its ability to accurately model future object motion. On Sim7, MotionRep achieves an ADE of 0.0447 m, an FDE of 0.0768 m, and a PWT of 0.5965. It also maintains stable and competitive performance on the real-world Real3 and SpatialCog benchmarks, indicating robustness to more complex appearance variations, interaction patterns, and motion distributions. Compared with methods that jointly generate future states and flow in pixel-reconstruction-oriented VAE latent spaces, MotionRep models future dynamics in the DINO representation space, providing richer semantic and geometric state constraints for flow generation. Overall, these results show that joint modeling in a visual representation space improves the trajectory accuracy and stability of 3D object flow generation.
blocks.zh: MotionRep在所有三个基准中都实现了强轨预测性能,显示了它准确模拟未来物体运动的能力. 在Sim7上,MotionRep实现0.0447米的ADE,0.0768米的FDE和0.5965的PWT. 它还在现实世界Real3和SpaceCog基准上保持了稳定和竞争性的性能,显示出更复杂的外观变化、互动模式和运动分布的稳健性。 相较于联合生成未来状态并流入以像素再造为导向的VAE潜在空间的方法,MotionRep模型在DINO表示空间中的未来动力学,为流出提供了更丰富的语义和几何状态限制. 总体而言,这些结果表明,在视觉表现空间进行联合模型制作可以提高3D物体流生成的轨迹精度和稳定性.

Out-of-Distribution Generalization. We further conduct out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation on the RoboMind dataset ( Hou et al., 2025 ) , which is not used during training, with results reported in Table 3 .
MotionRep maintains robust 3D object flow generation under substantial shifts in visual appearance, scene distributions, and language instructions, demonstrating stronger generalization than pixel-VAE-based baselines.
Notably, despite being trained on the same data as WorldFlow, MotionRep achieves better performance on the unseen RoboMind dataset, demonstrating stronger generalization to novel scenes and tasks.
These results further suggest that DINO representations reduce reliance on low-level appearance by capturing object semantics and spatial structure, providing a more transferable state representation for object-centric dynamics modeling across diverse scenes.

这些结果还进一步表明,DINO表示通过捕捉物体语义和空间结构来减少对低等外观的依赖,为不同场景的以物体为中心的动态模型提供更可转移的状态表示.

blocks.en:
Inference Efficiency. To evaluate the inference efficiency of MotionRep, we compare the inference steps and latency of different 3D object flow generation methods under identical hardware conditions. As shown in Table 3 , MotionRep predicts 48 future frames of 3D object flow in only 2.21 seconds, achieving 6 × \times and 83 × \times speedups over WorldFlow and MolmoMotion, respectively, demonstrating efficient joint generation.
This efficiency advantage benefits from the properties of the DINO representation space. Unlike pixel-reconstruction-oriented VAE latents, DINO representations emphasize object-level semantics and spatial geometry rather than low-level textures and appearance details. Modeling future states in this representation space therefore reduces the need to explicitly model complex high-frequency texture variations, enabling MotionRep to achieve high-quality joint generation of future visual representations and 3D object flow with only 3 sampling steps.

推论效率。 为了评价MotionRep的推论效率,我们比较了在相同的硬件条件下不同3D对象流生成方法的推论步骤和耐用性. 如表3所显示的,MotionRep只用2.21秒就预测出48个未来3D对象流的帧,分别通过WorldFlow和Molmomotion实现6×相和83×相和相和相和相和相快相,显示高效的联合生成.
这种效率优势得益于DINO代表空间的属性. 与像素-重构-面向VAE的潜想不同,DINO表示式强调物体级语义和空间几何,而不是低等纹理和外观细节. 因此,在这个表示空间中模拟未来状态会减少明确模拟复杂高频纹理变异的需要,使MotionRep能够实现高质量地联合生成未来视觉表现和只有3个采样步骤的3D物体流.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. We further qualitatively evaluate the generation results of MotionRep. Fig. 4 compares the predicted future DINO representations and 3D object flow with their ground-truth counterparts across diverse manipulation scenarios. MotionRep accurately captures object motion directions and overall trajectories, producing predictions that closely align with the ground truth in both trajectory shape and target positions across different tasks. Meanwhile, the predicted future DINO representations preserve object spatial structures and scene layouts, exhibiting strong consistency with the ground-truth representations. These results demonstrate that MotionRep effectively models future visual states and object-centric 3D motion jointly within a unified framework.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of DINO-VAE Representations
blocks.zh: 4.3 对DINO-VAE代表的分析

blocks.en:
DINO-VAE aims to compress DINO features while preserving information essential for effective world modeling. To assess its representation quality, we conduct two complementary evaluations. First, we apply semantic probes directly to the DINO-VAE latent space to examine whether the compressed representations retain high-level semantic structure. Second, we evaluate the reconstruction quality of DINO-VAE using frozen downstream task decoders.
Additional experimental results and implementation details are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
DINO-VAE旨在压缩DINO特征,同时保存对有效的世界建模至关重要的信息. 为了评估其代表性质量,我们进行了两项补充评价。 首先,我们将语义探测器直接应用于DINO-VAE潜在空间,以检查压缩表达是否保留了高层次语义结构. 第二,我们利用被冻结的下游任务解码器评估DINO-VAE的重建质量.
附录中提供了更多的实验结果和执行细节。

blocks.zh: 表4:DINO-VAE潜在空间的语义结构。 我们用UCF101上的顶一分类精度来评价语义信息保存. 单取和TTA分别表示单取和测试时间强化评价.

blocks.en: Semantic Structure of the Latent Space. Since MotionRep performs generative modeling directly in the DINO-VAE latent space, we evaluate the semantic information retained in the latent representation. Following the DINOv3 protocol, we train a linear probe on UCF101 ( Soomro et al., 2012 ) for classification. As shown in Table 4 , the original DINOv3-L features achieve a Top-1 accuracy of 92.84%, while the compressed DINO-VAE latent achieves 79.17%. In contrast, pixel-reconstruction-oriented video VAE latents from CogVideoX and Wan2.2 achieve only 14.51% and 16.94% ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . This substantial gap indicates that DINO-VAE retains considerably richer semantic structure in its latent space. Overall, the DINO-VAE latent preserves rich semantics under strong compression, enabling effective joint modeling of visual representations and flow.
blocks.zh: 后天空间的语义结构. 自动议以来 复制直接在DINO-VAE潜在空间中进行基因模型,我们评估潜在代表中保留的语义信息。 根据DINOv3协议,我们在UCF101(Soomro等,2012年)上培训了线性探测器进行分级. 如表4所示,最初的DINOv3-L特性的Top-1精度达到92.84%,而压缩的DINO-VAE潜能达到79.17%. 对比之下,从CogVideoX和Wan2.2的像素重建取向的视频VAE潜伏,只实现了14.51%和16.94%(Guo等,2026年). 这一巨大差距表明,DINO-VAE在其潜在空间中保留了更丰富的语义结构。 总体而言,DINO-VAE潜伏在强压缩下保留了丰富的语义,使得视觉表现和流能有效联合建模.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction Quality Evaluation. We evaluate the reconstruction quality of DINO-VAE using cosine similarity and MSE, and assess the preservation of geometric and semantic information in the reconstructed DINO features through depth estimation and semantic segmentation tasks.
Each decoder has fewer than 1M parameters and is trained only on original DINOv3-L features. We apply these frozen decoders to original DINO features, DINO-VAE reconstructions, and matched-budget PCA reconstructions. PCA serves as a linear compression baseline for DINO features. As shown in Table 5 , DINO-VAE reconstruction retains performance close to the original DINO features on depth estimation and semantic segmentation, while outperforming PCA reconstruction. This indicates that DINO-VAE enables high-quality reconstruction of DINO features while preserving geometric and semantic information.

每个解码器的参数都少于1M,并且只被训练在原DINov3-L特性上. 我们把这些被冻结的解码器 用于原始的DINO特性,DINO-VAE重建, 和匹配的预算的PCA重建。 五氯苯甲醚是DINO特性的线性压缩基线。 如表5所示,DINO-VAE的重建在深度估计和语义分解方面保留了接近最初的DINO特征的性能,同时优于PCA的重建. 这表明,DINO-VAE在保存几何和语义信息的同时,能够高质量地重建DINO特征.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We further conduct ablation studies on RoboTwin to assess the contribution of key components to 3D object flow generation ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , including DINO-VAE, future DINO generation, modality-specific noise scheduling, and visual representation world model pretraining, as summarized in Table 6 . Removing future DINO generation and conditioning flow only on first-frame DINO features increases ADE/FDE from 0.0315 / / 0.0738 to 0.0517 / / 0.1147, while PWT drops from 0.6570 to 0.5483. This shows that explicitly predicting DINO representations provides temporally evolving visual states that more effectively constrain flow generation.
Removing DINO-VAE and directly modeling the original DINO features also leads to performance degradation, demonstrating that the compact DINO-VAE latent space is better suited for generative modeling than high-dimensional DINO features.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步对RoboTwin进行扩展研究,以评估关键部件对三维物体流生成的贡献(Chen等,2025年b),包括DINO-VAE、未来的DINO生成、特定模式的噪声调度以及视觉表现世界模型预训,见表6。 仅从一机身DINO特性上去除未来的DINO生成和调节流,ADE/FDE从0.0315 / 0.0738增加到0.0517 / 0.1147. 而PWT则从0.6570下降到了0.5483. 这表明,明确预测DINO的表示提供了时间演化的视觉状态,从而更有效地制约了流量的生成.
移除DINO-VAE并直接模拟原始的DINO特征也会导致性能退化,表明紧凑的DINO-VAE潜入空间比高维的DINO特征更适合基因模型.

blocks.en:
Replacing modality-specific noise scheduling with a shared noise schedule degrades performance, indicating that asymmetric denoising enables visual representations to provide more effective guidance for flow generation.
In addition, joint training from random initialization underperforms pretrained initialization, suggesting that pretraining future DINO generation provides a useful dynamics prior for flow modeling. Overall, all ablations lead to performance degradation, demonstrating the complementary contributions of these components in MotionRep.

用共享的噪音时间表来取代特定模式的噪音调度会降低性能,表明不对称去诺能使视觉表达为流出提供更有效的指导.
此外,来自随机初始化的联合培训表现不佳,预训初始化,表明预训未来DINO一代为流建模提供了有用的前期动态. 总体而言,所有积分导致性能退化,表明这些组成部分在MotionRep中的互补性贡献.

blocks.en: 4.5 Bidirectional Dynamics Inference
blocks.zh: 4.5 双向动态推论

blocks.en: We evaluate the bidirectional conditional inference capability of MotionRep from two complementary directions: visual-conditioned inverse dynamics and flow-conditioned forward dynamics.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个互补方向评价运动的双向有条件推论能力:可视化反向动态和流化前向动态。

blocks.en:
Flow-Conditioned Forward Dynamics. We further evaluate MotionRep’s ability to generate DINO representations under flow conditioning. Given an initial visual state and the future 3D object flow, MotionRep treats the provided flow as a clean motion condition and generates the corresponding future DINO representations, thereby modeling scene evolution under the prescribed object motion.
As shown in the supplementary material, qualitative comparisons with ground-truth future DINO features show that the generated representations evolve consistently with the conditioned flow and the ground-truth scene evolution.
blocks.zh:
Flow-Controducted 前进动态. 我们进一步评价运动在流量调节下生成DINO表示的能力。 鉴于初始视觉状态和未来3D对象流,MotionRep将所提供流视为清洁运动条件并生成相应的未来DINO表示,从而在所指定对象运动下模拟场景演化.
正如补充材料所显示的,与地面实况未来DINO特征的定性比较表明,生成的表示与有条件的流动和地面实况演化一致地演变。

blocks.en:
Visual-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics. Under the inverse dynamics setting, we condition the model on future DINO representations and generate the corresponding 3D object flow from noise to evaluate its ability to estimate 3D object motion from future visual states.
We evaluate on Sim7 using ADE, FDE, and PWT, since it provides ground-truth 3D trajectories.
Results in Table 7 show that MotionRep effectively leverages future visual states to generate 3D object flow consistent with scene evolution, outperforming the 3D tracking method Track4World. We further provide qualitative results on real-world robotic manipulation data in the appendix.

我们利用ADE、FDE和PWT来评估Sim7,因为它提供了地基真实的三维轨道。
表7的结果显示,MotionRep有效地利用了未来的可视状态来生成符合场景演化的3D对象流,表现优于3D跟踪方法Track4World. 我们还在附录中提供关于现实世界机器人操纵数据的质量结果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow for object-centric dynamics modeling.
DINO-VAE compresses high-dimensional DINO features into compact generative latents while preserving semantic and geometric information.
Asymmetric denoising enables progressively refined future visual representations to guide 3D object flow generation.
Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep improves 3D object flow accuracy over the baselines, generalizes to unseen scenes, and enables efficient generation with only three denoising steps.
MotionRep further supports visual-conditioned inverse dynamics and flow-conditioned forward dynamics within the same model.
Together, these results demonstrate the value of explicitly predicting future visual representations for 3D object flow generation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了MotionRep,一种视觉表现世界模型,它联合生成未来的DINO表示和以物体为中心的动态模型的3D对象流.
DINO-VAE 压缩高维度 DINO在保存语义和几何信息的同时,将特征化为紧凑的基因潜质.
不对称去诺能使未来的视觉表现逐渐被精炼来引导三维对象流生成.
对模拟和现实世界基准的实验表明,MotionRep在基线上提高了3D对象流的精度,概括到看不见的场景,并且能够高效地生成,只有三个去名步骤.
MotionRep进一步支持可视化的反向动态和同模型内流化的前向动态.
这些结果共同显示了明确预测未来3D对象流生成的视觉表现值的价值.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. A key limitation of MotionRep is the difficulty of obtaining accurate 3D object flow annotations in real-world scenes, where supervision often relies on existing 3D trackers and may contain tracking noise. Future work will explore more reliable flow acquisition and extend MotionRep to longer-horizon tasks with more complex temporal dynamics.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 MotionRep的一个关键限制是在现实世界场景中难以获得准确的3D对象流注,在真实世界中,监管经常依赖于已存在的3D跟踪器并可能包含跟踪噪音. 今后的工作将探索更可靠的流量获取,并将MotionRep扩展至具有更复杂时间动态的较长范围的任务.

During training, since the number and spatial distribution of visual tokens vary with resolution, we follow the resolution-aware scheduling strategy of Cosmos3 and adjust s R s_{R} accordingly to accommodate different noise characteristics.
In contrast, we use a fixed timestep shift for 3D object flow during training, as the number of sampled points remains constant.
During inference, the visual representation and flow streams share the same solver progress but follow distinct denoising trajectories determined by their respective modality-specific schedules. This asymmetric denoising process allows progressively refined future visual states to provide continuous structural constraints for 3D object flow generation within the unified joint model.

在训练期间,由于视觉符号的数量和空间分布因分辨率而异,我们遵循Cosmos3的分辨率意识调度策略,并相应调整 s R s_{R}以适应不同的噪音特性.
相形之下,我们在训练时对3D对象流使用固定的时间步移,因为被采样的点数保持不变.
在推论中,可视化表现和流流共享相同的解析器进度,但遵循由各自模式特定时间表决定的显著去诺化轨迹. 这种不对称的去诺化过程可以使未来的视觉状态逐渐得到完善,为统一联合模型内的3D对象流生成提供持续的结构限制.

blocks.en: A.3 Unified Inference Modes
blocks.zh: A.3 统一推论模式

blocks.en: Benefiting from independent timestep sampling across modalities during training, MotionRep supports three inference modes within a unified generative framework: joint generation, visual-conditioned inverse dynamics, and flow-conditioned forward dynamics. As summarized in Table I , all three modes share the same model parameters and differ only in the conditioning and denoising configurations of future visual representations and 3D object flow.
blocks.zh: 从培训期间跨模式的独立时间步抽样中受益,MotionRep支持一个统一的基因框架内的三种推论模式:联合生成、可视化反向动态和流动化前向动态。 如表一所概括,所有三种模式都具有相同的模型参数,并且只在未来视觉表现和3D对象流的调制和去诺配置上有所不同.

blocks.en: In joint generation , both future visual representations and 3D object flow are initialized with Gaussian noise and jointly denoised following their respective modality-specific schedules. In inverse dynamics , ground-truth future DINO representations are provided as clean conditions, while only the flow stream is iteratively denoised to generate the corresponding 3D object motion. Conversely, forward dynamics conditions on the given clean 3D object flow and generates future visual representations consistent with the specified motion.

blocks.en:
We adapt the Cosmos3-Nano architecture, a mixture-of-transformers in which an understanding expert and a generation expert share one attention operation over one token sequence, and initialize
from its released weights. Cosmos3-Nano contains 15.18B parameters, of which 6.97B are trainable in the generation expert, while the remaining 8.21B parameters of the understanding expert are frozen.
The additional modules are lightweight, comprising a timestep embedding module, an object-flow branch, and two linear projection layers for visual representation input and output. These projections map between the 128-dimensional DINO-VAE latent space and the 4096-dimensional transformer hidden space. Both the DINOv3-L encoder and DINO-VAE remain frozen during training and are excluded from the reported parameter counts. The model configuration and key hyperparameters are summarized in Table III .

blocks.en: B.3 Training Setup
blocks.zh: B.3 培训设置

blocks.en: We adopt a two-stage training strategy consisting of DINO-only pretraining and joint DINO-flow training. In the first stage, we train the DINO DiT to model future visual representations without the object-flow branch. In the second stage, we initialize from the pretrained DINO DiT and introduce the object-flow branch to jointly model future visual representations and 3D object flow. We use 967,377 video clips collected from 11 data sources, grouped into three categories: Sim7, Real3, and SpatialCog, as detailed in Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们采取两阶段培训战略,包括只进行DINO预训和DINO-流动联合培训。 在第一阶段,我们训练DINO DIT来模拟未来没有对象流分支的视觉表现. 在第二阶段,我们从预先训练的DINO DIT上初始化,并引入了对象流分支来联合模拟未来的视觉表现和3D对象流. 我们使用从11个数据来源收集的967 377个录像片段,分为三类: Sim7, Real3,和SpaceCog,详见Sec.C.1.

blocks.en: To effectively leverage large-scale internet-sourced training data of varying origins and quality, we adopt a four-stage curriculum during joint DINO-flow training, progressively adjusting the sampling ratios across the three data categories. As summarized in Table IV , Stage A primarily uses simulated data to establish basic motion modeling capabilities. Stage B increases the proportion of SpatialCog, a curated in-house dataset, to facilitate adaptation to real-world environments. Stage C emphasizes Real3, a large-scale internet-sourced dataset, to improve real-world motion modeling. Finally, Stage D increases the sampling ratio of SpatialCog for final refinement. The curriculum spans 36,000 training iterations, with stage-specific sampling ratios and learning rates.
blocks.zh: 为了有效地利用不同来源和质量的大型因特网来源培训数据,我们在DINO-流量联合培训期间采用了一个四阶段课程,逐步调整三个数据类别的抽样比率。 如表四所概述,A阶段主要使用模拟数据来建立基本的运动建模能力. B阶段增加了空间记录仪这一内部数据集的比例,以促进适应现实环境。 C阶段强调Real3,一个大型互联网源数据集,来改进现实世界的运动模型制作. 最后,阶段 D增加了空间观测仪的取样率,以供最后改进。 课程涵盖36 000个培训周期,具有阶段性抽样比率和学习率。

blocks.en: Table IV: Four-stage curriculum training schedule of MotionRep. The data sampling ratios and learning rates are adjusted across different stages of joint DINO-flow training.
blocks.zh: 表四:动议四阶段课程培训时间表。 数据抽样比率和学习率在DINO-流量联合培训的不同阶段进行调整。

blocks.en: We train the joint model on 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, with approximately 40,000 iterations of DINO-only pretraining followed by 36,000 iterations of joint DINO-flow training. We use the AdamW optimizer with a global batch size of 64 packed sequences, each containing at most 55,296 tokens. An exponential moving average (EMA) of the model parameters is maintained throughout training, and the EMA weights are used for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们在64个NVIDIA H100 GPU上培训联合型号,大约40,000次重复只进行DINO预训,随后是36,000次重复进行DINO-流量联合培训. 我们使用亚当W优化器,其全球批量尺寸为64个包装序列,每个序列最多包含55,296个令牌. 在整个培训过程中都保持模型参数的指数移动平均值,并使用EMA权重进行评价。

blocks.en: B.4 Inference Setup
blocks.zh: B.4 推断设置

blocks.en: During inference, we use the EMA weights of the jointly trained model to generate future visual representations and 3D object flow, conditioned on the initial observation, 3D object query points, and language instruction. We employ the UniPC solver with 3 sampling steps and a classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale of 1.2. To facilitate few-step inference, we adopt smaller noise shifts to provide more balanced coverage of the denoising trajectory. We further set the visual representation shift lower than the flow shift, enabling progressively refined future visual states to guide 3D object flow generation. Finally, the generated visual latents are decoded into DINO features using the frozen DINO-VAE decoder, while the predicted 3D object flow is rescaled and added to the initial 3D point coordinates to recover future object trajectories.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,我们利用被联合训练的模型的EMA权重来生成未来的视觉表现和3D对象流,以初始观测,3D对象查询点,语言指示为条件. 我们使用UniPC解析器,有3个采样步骤和1.2的无分级制导(CFG)尺度. 为了便于几步推论,我们采用较小的噪声变化,以更平衡地覆盖去声轨迹。 我们进一步将视觉表现移比流向移低,使未来视觉状态逐渐得到完善来引导3D对象流产生. 最后,所生成的视觉潜想被用被冷冻的DINO-VAE解码器解码为DINO特性,而所预测的3D物体流被重新缩放并添加到初始的3D点坐标上来恢复未来的物体轨迹.

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: C.1 Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集和基准

blocks.en: We collect a total of 967,377 video clips from 11 data sources, spanning simulated environments, real-world internet videos, and in-house recordings. We organize the data into three groups: Sim7 , comprising seven simulation datasets (RoboTwin, Meta-World, ManiSkill, RoboCasa, MIKASA, RLBench, and MetaFold); Real3 , comprising three real-world datasets (AgiBot World, Something-Something v2, and EPIC-KITCHENS); and SpatialCog , an in-house real-world dataset with calibrated camera parameters. The detailed data composition is summarized in Table V . To prevent data leakage, we exclude evaluation clips from the training set.
blocks.zh: 我们从11个数据来源收集967,377个视频剪辑,包括模拟环境、现实世界互联网视频和内部录音。 我们把数据分为三组: Sim7,由7个模拟数据集组成(RoboTwin,Meta-World,ManiSkill,RoboCasa,MIKASA,RL Bench和MetaFold);Real3,由3个现实世界数据集组成(AgiBot World,Something v2和EPIC-KITCHENS);以及SpaceCog,一个内部真实世界数据集,有校准相机参数. 详细数据构成见表五。 为了防止数据泄露,我们把评价片段排除在培训内容之外。

blocks.en: For 3D object flow supervision, Sim7 directly uses ground-truth 3D motion provided by simulators, while 3D object trajectories in Real3 and SpatialCog are estimated from RGB videos using SAM 2 and Track4World. Specifically, we first segment the target object using SAM 2 and sample query points on its visible surface in the initial frame. We then track these points using Track4World and transform the reconstructed 3D points and their trajectories into the initial camera coordinate system using depth, camera intrinsics, and camera poses. All samples are associated with undistorted pinhole camera intrinsics. Sim7 provides ground-truth 3D geometry from simulators, SpatialCog provides calibrated camera parameters, and Real3 primarily relies on monocular estimation for 3D geometry.
blocks.zh: 对于3D对象流监控,Sim7直接使用由模拟器提供的地-真3D运动,而Real3和SpaceCog中的3D对象轨迹则从使用SAM 2和Track4World的RGB视频中估算出. 具体来说,我们首先用SAM 2来分出目标对象,并在初始框架的可见地表上取出样本查询点. 然后我们用Track4World追踪这些点,利用深度,相机内在,相机外形,将重建的3D点及其轨迹转换为初始相机坐标系统. 所有样品都与未分解的针孔相机所固有的相机有关. Sim7提供从模拟器得到的地-实 三维几何,SpaceCog提供校正相机参数,Real3主要依靠三维几何的单相机估计.

blocks.en: Beyond 3D object flow generation, we evaluate the representation capabilities of DINO-VAE on additional datasets. For depth estimation and semantic segmentation, we use held-out robotic manipulation videos. For video representation evaluation, we use UCF101 following the evaluation protocol of DINOv3.
blocks.zh: 除了3D对象流生成,我们评价DINO-VAE在附加数据集上的能表现能力. 对于深度估计和语义分类, 我们使用被搁置的机器人操纵视频。 对于视频表现评价,我们在DINOv3的评价协议后使用UCF101.

blocks.en: We evaluate the 3D object flow generation capabilities of MotionRep on WorldFlowBench ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , which consists of 1,678 object interaction and manipulation clips from simulated and real-world environments. The benchmark is divided into three evaluation groups: Sim7 (396 clips), Real3 (882 clips), and SpatialCog (400 clips). Each evaluation sample contains an initial RGB frame at a resolution of 288 × 480 288\times 480 , a natural-language task description, and 64 object query points specified by their pixel coordinates in the initial frame. The corresponding 3D trajectories span 49 sampled frames, including the initial frame and 48 future frames.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了"活花奔驰"(Lu等,2026b)上"活花奔驰"(MotionRep)的3D对象流生成能力,由模拟和现实世界环境中的1,678个对象交互和操纵剪辑组成. 基准分为三个评价组:Sim7(396个剪辑),Real3(882个剪辑)和SpaceCog(400个剪辑). 每个评价样本包含一个分辨率为288×480 288\times 480的初始RGB框架,一个自然语言任务描述,以及其像素坐标在初始框架中指定的64个对象查询点. 相应的三维轨距跨越了49个被取样的相框,包括初始相框和48个未来相框.

blocks.en: C.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate 3D object flow generation using Average Displacement Error (ADE), Final Displacement Error (FDE), and Percentage Within Threshold (PWT). ADE measures the mean 3D Euclidean position error across all query points and timesteps, while FDE measures the mean position error at the final timestep. PWT measures the fraction of point-frame predictions within distance thresholds of 1, 2, and 5 cm, averaged across the three thresholds. ADE and FDE are reported in meters. All metrics are computed over the prediction horizon and then averaged across clips within each evaluation group.
blocks.zh: 我们利用平均迁移出错(ADE)、最终迁移出错(FDE)和临界值内的百分比(PWT)来评估三维对象流生成。 ADE 测量所有查询点和时间步的平均值为 3D Euclidean 位置错误,而FDE 测量最后时间步的平均值位置错误. PWT测量距离阈值1,2和5厘米范围内的点框预测的分量,平均跨出三个阈值. ADE和FDE以米计报告. 所有衡量标准都是在预测范围内计算,然后在每个评价组内通过剪辑进行平均计算。

blocks.en: For depth estimation, we report Absolute Relative Error (AbsRel), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and δ 1 \delta_{1} . AbsRel measures the mean absolute relative depth error, RMSE measures the root mean squared depth error, and δ 1 \delta_{1} denotes the fraction of pixels with a predicted-to-ground-truth depth ratio within a factor of 1.25. For semantic segmentation, we report mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), averaged across five semantic classes.
blocks.zh: 关于深度估计,我们报告绝对相对错误(AbsRel),根平均平方错误(RMSE),和\\delta\1}。 AbsRel测量平均绝对相对深度误差,RMSE测量了根平均平方深度误差,而 \\\delta\\1}表示在 1.25 系数内有预测到地-真实深度比的像素分量. 对于语义分解,我们报告指的是跨联盟(mIoU)的分解,平均分为五个语义类.

blocks.en: Following the DINOv3 evaluation protocol, we assess the semantic structure of visual representations using top-1 classification accuracy on UCF101. We report results under two inference settings: Single and test-time augmentation (TTA). Single uses a deterministic temporal sampling strategy covering the first and last frames, with uniformly spaced intermediate frames, and a central square crop. TTA averages the predicted class probabilities across six views, constructed from three spatial crops and two temporally interleaved frame sequences.
blocks.zh: 根据DINOv3评价协议,我们使用UCF101上的顶一分类精度来评估视觉表现的语义结构. 我们报告在两个推断设置下的结果:单一和试验时间增强。 单子采用决定时间采样策略,覆盖了第一个和最后一个相框,中间相框统一间隔,并有中央正方形相框. TTA对从三个空间作物和两个时间相间框架序列构造的6个观点的预测类概率进行平均值.

blocks.en: C.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 基线

blocks.en:
We compare MotionRep against three categories of baselines: video-generation-and-tracking pipelines that estimate 3D motion from generated videos, direct-flow methods that predict future 3D trajectories without explicit RGB video generation, and joint visual-flow generation methods that model future visual states and 3D motion together.
All methods are evaluated under the same conditioning setting, using a single initial observation, a natural-language task description, and initial 3D query points.
blocks.zh:
我们比较MotionRep与三类基线:视频生成和跟踪管道,这些管道从生成的视频中估计出3D运动,直接流出方法,预测未来的3D轨迹,而没有明确的RGB视频生成,以及联合视觉流出方法,模拟未来视觉状态和3D运动在一起.
所有方法都在同一条件设置下进行评估,使用单个初始观测,自然语言任务描述,以及初始3D查询点.

blocks.en:
NovaFlow ( Li et al., 2025 ) generates future videos conditioned on the initial observation and task description, and subsequently extracts actionable 3D object flow using off-the-shelf perception modules.
Cosmos3-Nano + Track4World combines Cosmos3-Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) for future RGB video generation with Track4World ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , a feed-forward world-centric 3D tracker, to recover 3D point trajectories.
Cosmos3-Nano + 4RC replaces Track4World with 4RC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , which reconstructs 3D geometry and motion from generated monocular videos.
LingBot-Video-MoE + Track4World uses LingBot-Video-MoE ( Ma et al., 2026 ) for autoregressive video generation, followed by Track4World for 3D trajectory estimation.
LingBot-Video-MoE + 4RC similarly combines LingBot-Video-MoE with 4RC for 3D motion reconstruction.
These methods estimate 3D motion through an intermediate video-generation stage, making their performance dependent on both video generation and subsequent 3D tracking or reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
NovaFlow(Li等,2025年)生成未来以初始观测和任务描述为条件的视频,并随后使用现成的感知模块来提取可操作的3D对象流.
宇宙3-纳诺+轨道4 World将Cosmos3-Nano(NVIDIA,2026年)为未来RGB视频生成与Track4World(Lu等,2026a年),以Feed-forward World-Centre 3D tracker,以收复3D点轨迹.
Cosmos3-Nano + 4RC将Track4World替换为4RC(Luo等,2026年),它从所生成的单相视频中重建出3D几何和运动.
LingBot-Video-MoE + Track4World 使用LingBot-Video-MoE(Ma等,2026年)进行自回式视频生成,后由 Track4World进行3D轨迹估计.
LingBot-Video-MoE + 4RC类似地将LingBot-Video-MoE与4RC结合用于3D运动重建.
这些方法通过中间视频生成阶段估计出3D运动,使其性能既依赖于视频生成,也依赖于随后的3D跟踪或重建.

blocks.en:
MolmoMotion-AR (H1) ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) autoregressively predicts language-conditioned 3D point trajectories by representing coordinates as discrete tokens. μ 0 \mu_{0} ( Lee et al., 2026 ) directly models future trajectories of semantic interaction points in a normalized, anchor-relative 3D trace space.
EgoWAM ( Li et al., 2026a ) models future dynamics beyond pixels, including a 3D-flow variant that predicts camera-stabilized 3D motion.
Unlike video-generation-and-tracking pipelines, these methods directly predict geometric motion without generating RGB videos.
blocks.zh:
Mollmotion-AR (H1) (Zhang等, 2026年) 自动地通过将坐标作为离散符号来预测语言条件的3D点轨迹. μ 0\mu_{0} (Lee等, 2026年) 直接将语义相互作用点的未来轨迹模拟在一个正态的,锚相相相通的3D跟踪空间.
EgoWAM (Li等, 2026a) 模拟了像素以外的未来动态,包括一个预测相机稳定3D运动的3D流变体.
与视频生成和跟踪管不同,这些方法直接预测几何运动而不产生RGB视频.

blocks.en: WorldFlow ( Lu et al., 2026b ) jointly models future RGB video and 3D object flow within a unified generative framework, serving as the most directly comparable baseline to MotionRep.
blocks.zh: WorldFlow (Lu et al., 2026b.)联合在统一的基因框架内模拟未来的RGB视频和3D对象流,作为MotionRep最直接可比较的基线.

blocks.en: C.4 DINO-VAE Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: C.4 DINO-VAE评价议定书

blocks.en: To assess the semantic information retained in compressed DINO-VAE latents, we follow the DINOv3 evaluation protocol and perform linear probing on UCF101. Specifically, we apply spatial and temporal pooling to the video representations extracted by each model to obtain video-level feature vectors, which are then passed through LayerNorm and a single linear classifier for video classification. The classifier is trained for 20 epochs using cross-entropy loss. Under the same evaluation protocol, we compare the original DINOv3-L features, DINO-VAE latents, and video VAE latents from CogVideoX and Wan2.2 to evaluate their ability to preserve high-level semantic information.
blocks.zh: 为了评估压缩的DINO-VAE潜伏物中保留的语义信息,我们遵循DINOv3评价协议,对UCF101进行线性检测. 具体来说,我们把空间和时间集合应用于每个模型所提取的视频表达,以获得视频级特征向量,然后通过LayerNorm和一个用于视频分类的单线性分类器来传递. 分级器是用来训练20个纪元的,使用交叉收缩. 根据同样的评价协议,我们比较了来自CogVideoX和Wan2.2的原始DINOv3-L特性,DINO-VAE潜想和视频VAE潜想,以评估它们保存高层次语义信息的能力.

blocks.en: We evaluate the quality of reconstructed DINO features and compressed DINO-VAE latents using MSE, cosine similarity, and frozen downstream decoder to assess the preservation of geometric and semantic information. The depth decoder is a lightweight convolutional network with 0.63M parameters, taking only the last-layer DINO feature as input. It constructs four feature scales from a single feature and progressively fuses them through top-down upsampling, producing a single-channel positive depth map at the input image resolution. The training objective combines a disparity-space data term, a scale-invariant logarithmic loss, a gradient loss, and an edge loss, with larger weights assigned to the latter two to improve depth boundary preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们利用MSE、同位素相似性以及被冻结的下游解码器来评估几何和语义信息的保存情况。 深度解码器是一个有0.63M参数的轻量级分解网络,仅取上层的DINO特征作为输入. 它从一个单一特性构造出四个特性尺度,并通过自上而下地取出上下取样来逐渐将它们相接而成,在输入图像分辨率上生成出一个单通道正深度图. 训练目标结合了相差相差相差的数据术语,相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相多相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差

blocks.en: The segmentation decoder employs a lightweight decoder with 0.76M parameters. It constructs multi-scale features from the same DINO feature through four parallel projection branches and fuses them to produce per-pixel semantic predictions. The segmentation task comprises five classes: background, table, robot, clutter, and the currently manipulated object. The training objective combines equally weighted cross-entropy and Dice losses, with inverse-frequency class weights computed from the training split to mitigate class imbalance.
blocks.zh: 分解解码器采用有0.76M参数的轻量级解码器. 它通过四个平行的投影分会从同一个DINO特性中构建出多尺度特征,并导出它们以产生每个像素语义的预测. 分块任务由五类组成:背景,表,机器人,杂交,以及目前被操纵的对象. 培训目标结合了同等加权的交叉竞争和Dice损失,从培训中分拆计算出逆频课重来缓解班级不平衡。

blocks.en: We adopt a lightweight ViT RGB decoder ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , initialized from a pretrained RAE pixel decoder and subsequently fine-tuned on our data, to map the last-layer DINO features back to pixel space. When reconstructing future RGB frames, we further introduce a lightweight first-frame reference module that leverages high-frequency information from the initial RGB frame to recover texture details not fully preserved in DINO features, thereby improving the visual quality of reconstructed videos.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种轻量级的VIT RGB解码器(Zheng等,2026年),由经过预训的RAE像素解码器初始化,并随后在我们的数据上进行微调,将上层的DINO特征映射回像素空间. 在重建未来的RGB帧时,我们进一步引入了轻量级一帧参考模块,利用从最初的RGB帧得到的高频信息来回收DINO特征中未完全保存的纹理细节,从而提高了被重建的视频的视觉质量.

blocks.en: We apply principal component analysis (PCA) to visualize the spatial structure of DINO-VAE latents. Specifically, we project the latent features onto the first three principal components and map them to the RGB channels to obtain spatial feature visualizations. Regions with similar colors correspond to more similar representations in the projected feature space, providing a qualitative view of the spatial structure preserved after temporal and channel compression.
blocks.zh: 我们采用主要组件分析(PCA)可视化DINO-VAE潜伏物的空间结构. 具体来说,我们把潜在的特征投射到前三个主要组件上,并将其映射到RGB频道,以获得空间特征可视化. 颜色相近的区域对应了预测地物空间中较为相近的表示,提供了在时间和信道压缩后保存的空间结构的质观.

blocks.en: C.5 Out-of-Distribution Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.5 分发外评价议定书

blocks.en: To further assess the out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of MotionRep, we evaluate it on RoboMIND 2.0, a dataset entirely excluded from training. This dataset encompasses diverse manipulation scenes and tasks unseen during training, enabling us to assess the model’s ability to predict 3D object motion under distribution shifts. We select 200 video clips from RoboMIND 2.0 and follow the same evaluation protocol, metrics, and settings as WorldFlowBench. The results are reported in main paper.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估分配外(OO)对MotionRep的概括性,我们在RoboMIND 2.0上对它进行评估,这个数据集完全被排除在培训之外. 这个数据集包含训练期间所未见的各种操纵场景和任务,使我们能够评估该模型在分配变化中预测三维物体运动的能力。 我们从 RoboMIND 2.0 中选择了 200 个视频片段, 并遵循与 WorldFlow Bench 相同的评价协议, 度量,和设置 。 主要文件报告了结果。

blocks.en: C.6 Inference Efficiency Details
blocks.zh: C.6 推论效率细节

blocks.en: To ensure a fair and reproducible evaluation of inference efficiency, we conduct all measurements on an NVIDIA H800 GPU with a batch size of 1. We select 50 samples from each of the three WorldFlowBench evaluation groups, Sim7, Real3, and SpatialCog, and use the same samples to evaluate all methods. We compare inference efficiency against several baseline methods that achieve strong performance in 3D object flow generation.
blocks.zh: 为了确保对推论效率进行公平和可再生的评价,我们对批量尺寸为1的NVIDIA H800 GPU进行所有测量。 我们从Sim7,Real3和SpaceCog三个世界花本评估组中各选取50个样本,并使用相同的样本来评价所有方法. 我们比较推论效率与在三维对象流生成中实现强性能的几种基准方法.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他实验结果

blocks.en: In this section, we provide additional experimental results of MotionRep, including DINO-VAE representation analysis, downstream evaluations of reconstructed DINO features, joint generation of future DINO representations and 3D object flow, and bidirectional dynamics inference.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了MotionRep的额外实验结果,包括DINO-VAE代表分析,重建的DINO特征下游评价,联合生成未来的DINO表示和3D对象流,以及双向动态推论.

blocks.en: D.1 DINO-VAE Representation Analysis
blocks.zh: D.1 DINO-VAE 代表分析

blocks.en: D.1.1 PCA Visualization of Latent Representations
blocks.zh: D.1.1 五氯苯甲醚 近代代表形象化

blocks.en: We compare the spatial structures of original DINOv3-L features, compressed DINO-VAE latents, and Wan2.2 VAE latents using PCA visualization to assess their preservation of semantic and geometric information. As shown in Fig. II , the original DINOv3-L features exhibit clear object-level spatial structures, with distinct feature regions corresponding to different objects and foreground-background boundaries. Despite temporal and channel compression, DINO-VAE latents largely preserve this spatial organization, exhibiting coherent feature distributions with strong object-level consistency. In contrast, Wan2.2 VAE latents exhibit more fine-grained noise-like variations and fragmented spatial patterns, with less distinct object boundaries and regional structures.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了原始的DINOv3-L特征的空间结构、压缩的DINO-VAE潜质和Wan2.2 VAE潜质,利用PCA可视化来评估它们保存的语义和几何信息。 如图二所示,最初的DINOv3-L地貌呈现出清晰的物体级空间结构,其显著的地貌区域对应不同的物体和前地-后地边界. 尽管时间和频道压缩,DINO-VAE潜伏物在很大程度上保留了这种空间组织,显示出具有很强的物体级一致性的连贯特征分布. 相形之下,Wan2.2 VAE 潜伏物呈现出更细微的类似噪声的变异和零散的空间模式,其物体界限和区域结构的区别较小.

blocks.en:
These observations suggest that DINO-VAE preserves the informative semantic and spatial structures of the original DINO features while substantially compressing their dimensionality.
Compared with pixel-oriented VAE latents containing substantial local high-frequency variations, such coherent and structured representations allow generative models to focus on object-level semantics, spatial relationships, and dynamic changes, thereby improving inference efficiency and generalization.
Together with the ablation results in the main paper, these findings further support the effectiveness of DINO-VAE as a latent space for jointly generating future visual representations and 3D object flow.
blocks.zh:
这些观测结果表明,DINO-VAE保留了原始DINO特征的信息语义和空间结构,同时实质性地压缩了它们的维度.
相较于以像素为导向并含有大量局部高频变化的VAE潜质,这种连贯而有条理的表示方式使得基因模型能够专注于对象层次的语义,空间关系,以及动态变化,从而提高推论效率和通论性.
这些发现与主论文中的衰减结果一起,进一步支持了DINO-VAE作为共同生成未来视觉表现和三维物体流的潜在空间的有效性.

blocks.en: D.1.2 Geometric Information in DINO-VAE Latents
blocks.zh: D.1.2 DINO-VAE Latents中的几何信息

blocks.en: To evaluate the geometric information preserved by DINO-VAE, we independently train lightweight depth decoders on the original DINOv3-L features and compressed DINO-VAE latents, and assess their depth estimation performance using AbsRel, RMSE, and δ 1 \delta_{1} . As shown in Table VI , despite temporal and channel compression, DINO-VAE latents achieve performance close to the original DINO features. These results demonstrate that DINO-VAE effectively preserves geometric information under substantial compression, providing a compact representation space for future state generation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价DINO-VAE保存的几何信息,我们独立地根据最初的DINOv3-L特性和压缩的DINO-VAE潜质来训练轻量级深度解码器,并使用AbsRel, RMSE, 和 \\\ delta\ 1}来评估它们的深度估计性能. 如表六所示,尽管时间和信道压缩,DINO-VAE潜伏性能还是接近了最初的DINO特性. 这些结果表明,DINO-VAE在大量压缩下有效保存了几何信息,为后一世代提供了紧凑的表示空间.

blocks.en: Table VI: Geometric information preservation in DINO-VAE latents. Despite substantial temporal and channel compression, DINO-VAE latents preserve rich geometric information.
blocks.zh: 表六:DINO-VAE潜在几何信息保存。 尽管时间和频道压缩很大,但DINO-VAE潜伏物仍保存了丰富的几何信息.

blocks.en: D.1.3 Reconstruction Quality and Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: D.1.3 重建质量和下游任务

blocks.en: To further evaluate the reconstruction quality of DINO-VAE and its ability to support diverse downstream visual tasks, we apply the reconstructed DINO features to depth estimation, semantic segmentation, and RGB reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价DINO-VAE的重建质量及其支持各种下游视觉任务的能力,我们将重建后的DINO特征应用于深度估计,语义分解,以及RGB重建.

blocks.en: We decode reconstructed DINO features into RGB images and conduct both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. As shown in Table VII , the reconstructed images achieve a PSNR of 30.28 dB, an SSIM of 0.9536, and an LPIPS of 0.1375. As illustrated in Fig. III , the reconstructions exhibit strong consistency with ground-truth RGB frames in scene layout, object appearance, and texture details. These results demonstrate that DINO-VAE reconstructed features support high-quality RGB reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们把DINO特征重新编译成RGB图像,并进行定量和定性评估。 如表七所示,所重建的图像达到30.28 dB的PSNR,0.9536的SSIM和0.1375的LPIPS. 如图三所示,在场景布局、物体外观和纹理细节方面,重建显示与地面真实的RGB框架有很强的一致性。 这些结果表明,DINO-VAE重建的特征支持了高质量的RGB重建.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. IV , the predicted depth maps preserve the overall spatial structure of different manipulation scenes and distinguish relative depth relationships among robots, manipulated objects, and background regions. Across robotic manipulation and tabletop interaction scenarios, the depth predictions capture the spatial arrangement of major objects and their geometric relationships with the surrounding environment. These results provide further qualitative evidence that DINO-VAE reconstructed features retain useful geometric information for dense depth estimation.
blocks.zh: 如图四所示,预测深度图保留了不同操纵场景的整体空间结构,并区分了机器人,被操纵物体,和背景区域之间的相对深度关系. 纵观机器人操纵和平面交互情景,深度预测可以捕捉主要物体的空间安排及其与周围环境的几何关系. 这些结果提供了进一步的定性证据,证明DINO-VAE重建的地貌保留了有用的几何信息来进行密集的深度估计.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. V , the predicted segmentation maps distinguish major semantic regions, including tables, robots, background, and manipulated objects, while maintaining relatively clear object-level boundaries across diverse manipulation scenarios. Together with the quantitative results in the main paper, these visualizations further demonstrate that DINO-VAE reconstructed features preserve spatial structures and object-level semantic information useful for dense semantic prediction.
blocks.zh: 如来所显示. V,预测分解图区分出主要语义区域,包括表格,机器人,背景,被被操纵的对象,同时在不同的被操纵情景中保持相对清晰的物体级边界. 这些可视化与正文中的定量结果一起,进一步表明DINO-VAE重建的特征保存了空间结构和物体级语义信息,对密集语义预测有用.

blocks.en: Table VII : RGB reconstruction quality of DINO-VAE. We evaluate RGB images decoded from DINO-VAE reconstructed features using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
blocks.zh: 表七:DINO-VAE的RGB重建质量. 我们用PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS 来评价从 DINO-VAE 重建的特性解码的 RGB 图像.

blocks.en: D.2 Joint Generation Results
blocks.zh: D.2 联合生成成果

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative results of jointly generated future DINO representations and 3D object flow across diverse manipulation scenarios. As shown in Fig. VI ,
MotionRep produces future DINO representations that closely match the ground truth in overall scene layout, object-level structures, and spatial changes across diverse manipulation tasks, including object placement, drawer interactions, and lid closing. Meanwhile, the predicted 3D object flow captures the primary motion directions and trajectory evolution of manipulated objects, with motion patterns and final positions closely aligned with the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了联合生成的未来DINO表示和不同操纵情景的三维对象流动的额外质量结果。 如图六所示,
MotionRep生成未来DINO的表示,在整体场景布局,对象级别结构,以及不同操纵任务的空间变化,包括对象放置,抽屉互动,和盖子关闭中紧密匹配地面真理. 与此同时,所预测的3D物体流能捕捉被操纵物体的主要运动方向和轨迹演化,运动规律和最终位置与地面真理紧密地相通.

blocks.en: D.3 Bidirectional Dynamics Inference
blocks.zh: D.3 双向动态推论

blocks.en: Beyond joint generation, we further provide qualitative results for visual-conditioned inverse dynamics and flow-conditioned forward dynamics to examine the bidirectional conditional dependencies between future visual states and object motion.
blocks.zh: 除了联合生成之外,我们还为视觉条件反向动态和流向前向动态提供了定性结果,以审查未来视觉状态和物体运动之间的双向条件依赖关系。

blocks.en: For forward dynamics inference, we provide ground-truth 3D object flow as a condition and generate the corresponding future DINO representations. As illustrated in Fig. VII , the generated representations remain consistent with the ground-truth features in overall spatial layout, major object structures, and scene evolution. As the object moves, the generated DINO features capture its spatial changes in a manner consistent with the ground-truth DINO features, while preserving the relatively stable background structure.
blocks.zh: 对于前向动态推论,我们提供地-实 三维对象流作为条件,并生成相应的未来DINO表示. 如图七所示,生成的表示与总体空间布局、主要物体结构和场景演变中的地貌真实特征保持一致。 随着物体的移动,所生成的DINO特征以与地-地-地-地-地-地的DINO特征一致的方式捕捉其空间变化,同时保持相对稳定的背景结构.

blocks.en: For inverse dynamics inference, we provide ground-truth future DINO representations as conditions and generate the corresponding 3D object flow. As shown in Fig. VIII , the predicted trajectories exhibit strong agreement with the ground truth in motion direction, temporal evolution, and overall displacement across real-world and simulated manipulation scenarios. In scenes involving object movement and robotic interactions, MotionRep effectively infers 3D motion from the spatial changes encoded in future visual representations. These results indicate that future DINO representations not only describe scene states but also provide informative conditions for object-centric motion inference.
blocks.zh: 对于反向动态推论,我们提供地-实未来DINO表示作为条件,并生成相应的三维对象流. 如图八所示,预测的轨迹在运动方向、时间演变和整个现实世界和模拟操纵情景中都与地面真理有着强烈的一致。 在涉及物体移动和机器人交互的场景中,MotionRep从未来视觉表现所编码的空间变化中有效地推断出3D运动. 这些结果显示,未来的DINO表述不仅描述了场景状态,还为以物体为中心的运动推论提供了信息性条件.

blocks.en: Figure II : PCA visualization of representation structure. We map the first three principal components of DINOv3-L features, compressed DINO-VAE latents, and Wan2.2 VAE latents to RGB channels. Regions with similar colors indicate similar feature representations in the projected space. DINO-VAE largely preserves the object-level semantic and geometric organization of the original DINO features, while Wan2.2 VAE exhibits a more entangled feature structure with weaker separation between objects and background.
blocks.zh: 图 二:常设仲裁法院代表结构的可视化。 我们绘制了DINov3-L特性的前三个主要组件,压缩了DINO-VAE潜质,Wan2.2 VAE潜入了RGB通道. 颜色相近的区域在所预测的空间中表示类似的地物表示. DINO-VAE在很大程度上保留了原DINO特征的物体级语义和几何组织,而Wan2.2 VAE则显示出更缠绕的特征结构,对象和背景的分离更弱.

blocks.en: Figure III : RGB reconstruction from DINO-VAE reconstructed features. We compare ground-truth RGB images with RGB reconstructions obtained by passing DINO-VAE reconstructed DINO features through an RGB decoder. The reconstructed images preserve the overall scene structure, object appearance, and spatial details of the original observations.
blocks.zh: 图三:由DINO-VAE重建的RGB重建. 我们把地面真实的RGB图像与通过DINO-VAE通过一个RGB解码器重建的DINO特征获得的RGB重建相提并论. 被重建的图像保留了原观测的整体场景结构,物体外观,以及空间细节.

blocks.en: Figure IV : Depth estimation from DINO-VAE reconstructed features. The lightweight frozen depth decoder captures scene geometry and relative depth relationships between objects and their surroundings.
blocks.zh: 图四:DINO-VAE重建特征的深度估计。 轻量级被冻结的深度解码器能捕捉到场景几何和物体与其周围的相对深度关系.

blocks.en:
Figure V : Semantic segmentation from DINO-VAE reconstructed features. The lightweight frozen decoder preserves clear object-level semantic regions across diverse manipulation scenes.
Gray, brown, red, blue, and green denote the background, table, robot, clutter, and manipulated object, respectively.

灰色,褐色,红色,蓝色,和绿色分别表示背景,桌子,机器人,杂色,被操纵的对象.

blocks.en: Figure VI : Joint generation of 3D object flow and future DINO representations. MotionRep jointly predicts future DINO representations and 3D object flow, producing visual states and object trajectories consistent with the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图六:三维对象流与未来DINO表示的联合生成. 动议 复制共同预测未来的DINO表示和3D对象流,产生与地真相符合的视觉状态和对象轨迹.

blocks.en: Figure VII : Visualization of flow-conditioned forward dynamics. Given ground-truth 3D object flow, MotionRep generates future DINO representations consistent with the corresponding scene evolution.
blocks.zh: 图七:可视化流量条件前向动态. 鉴于地-地3D对象流,MotionRep生成出与相应场景演化一致的未来DINO表示.

blocks.en: Figure VIII : Visualization of visual-conditioned inverse dynamics. Given ground-truth future DINO representations, MotionRep predicts 3D object flow that closely follows the ground-truth trajectories.
